package.name: wojtek_follow
package.description:
Follow a target the operator picked on the Deck, using the tower camera for the bearing and the front D435 for the range and the obstacles.
Two loops. The aim relay turns the Deck's 10 Hz track and the body's gyro into a 40 Hz target for the targeting gimbal, so the lock holds while the body turns. The body loop turns the bearing, the range and a three-band obstacle gate into a velocity.
This package publishes /wojtek/follow/cmd_vel, which the Deck gateway treats as one drive source among several. It never publishes /cmd_vel, it never talks to ros2_control, and it arms nothing.
Experimental. Nothing here is deployed by ros/deploy.sh and nothing in ros/src may depend on it.
